about: The back tap step for the Katana (milestone-1 task 57, the owner's answers of Oct 8): a tap step: 0.55 m on the Hunter in 4 frames (the rules' 8) at an even pace from the first frame (its instant start), the lead foot stepping and the trail following a frame behind; keyed as legs and hips only (the grip's guard or block plays above them) from the Katana's two-handed guard (katana_guard's first frame), each step lifting its foot 16 cm in place, travelling while up and setting it down in place, so the foot lock never drags a planted foot. All the clips of one kind share its length and travel, so the rules hold one profile per kind. Every frame kept as a key pose: Cascadeur's inbetweening would move planted feet. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
